books.title: Conversations with God: An Uncommon Dialogue, Book 1
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: The book that began it all — an angry letter to God that unexpectedly answered back. Walsch's raw, questioning dialogue tackles love, money, relationships and fear with disarming directness, and has sold millions worldwide since 1995. If a reader starts anywhere in this body of work, it starts here.

books.title: Conversations With God: An Uncommon Dialogue, Book 2
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: The dialogue widens from personal life to collective life — politics, education, sexuality and the structures that shape whole societies. Book 2 is the most socially provocative of the trilogy, asking what a civilisation built on oneness would actually look like.

books.title: Conversations With God: An Uncommon Dialogue, Book 3
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: The trilogy's closing volume turns to the largest questions of all — the soul's journey, other realms, evolved civilisations and what happens after death. Many readers find this the most expansive and consoling of the three.

books.title: The Complete Conversations with God: An Uncommon Dialogue
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: All three volumes of the original dialogue gathered into a single commemorative edition. For readers who already know they want the whole journey, this is the most economical and the most beautiful way to own it.

books.title: Friendship with God: An Uncommon Dialogue
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Where the trilogy explained, this book invites intimacy — moving the relationship with the Divine from awe to genuine friendship. Warm and disarmingly personal, it reframes spiritual practice as companionship rather than obligation.

books.title: Communion with God
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: The third book in the With God series dismantles what Walsch calls the Ten Illusions of Humans — need, failure, disunity, judgement and the rest. It is the most philosophically structured of his works and the one readers most often return to.

books.title: Conversations with God, Book 4: Awaken the Species
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Two decades after Book 3, the dialogue resumed with its most urgent question: what would a highly evolved species do differently? Sixteen distinctions between human behaviour and evolved behaviour form a practical blueprint for the next leap.

books.title: Home with God: In a Life That Never Ends
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: A sustained, gentle conversation about dying — what it is, what it isn't, and why Walsch's dialogue insists there is nothing there to fear. Widely passed between people facing bereavement or their own diagnosis.

books.title: The Little Soul and the Sun: A Children's Parable
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: A luminous picture-book parable about a small soul who wants to know itself as forgiveness — and the friend who agrees to do something unforgivable so it can. Adults tend to be as moved as the children they read it to.

books.title: The New Revelations: A Conversation with God
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Written in the shadow of religious violence, this volume argues that humanity's crisis is spiritual rather than political. It offers Five Steps to Peace and a frank examination of the beliefs that keep conflict alive.

books.title: Happier Than God: Turn Ordinary Life into an Extraordinary Experience
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Walsch's most practical treatment of creation and personal magnetism, going beyond conventional law-of-attraction thinking to ask what it is in us that does the attracting. Direct, exercise-led and unusually cheerful.

books.title: When Everything Changes, Change Everything
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: A field guide for seasons of upheaval — job loss, illness, the end of a relationship — built around nine changes that alter how change itself lands on you. The most useful of his books for someone in the middle of a hard year.

books.title: Tomorrow's God: Our Greatest Spiritual Challenge
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Nine sweeping predictions about how humanity's idea of the Divine is already shifting, and what a post-religious spirituality might hold. Bold, contentious and frequently ahead of its 2004 publication date.

books.title: What God Wants: A Compelling Answer to Humanity's Biggest Question
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: A short, forceful book built around a single question and an answer most readers do not expect. Walsch traces how much human suffering flows from getting that one answer wrong.

books.title: The Only Thing That Matters
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Book 2 of the Conversations with Humanity series argues that most people spend their lives on things that matter far less than they think. A clarifying read for anyone sensing they are busy with the wrong things.

books.title: What God Said: The 25 Core Messages of Conversations with God
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Three thousand pages of dialogue distilled into 25 core messages, each with commentary on living it. The ideal entry point for readers who want the substance of the whole canon in one volume.

books.title: Conversations with God for Teens
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Real questions from teenagers — about sex, identity, parents, purpose and death — answered in the same plain-spoken dialogue form. Refreshingly free of condescension, and often given by parents who can't find the words themselves.

books.title: God's Message to the World: You've Got Me All Wrong
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: A pointed correction of seventeen widely held beliefs about the Divine — that God judges, punishes, demands worship. Short, bracing, and among his most quoted works.

books.title: The Essential Path: Making the Daring Decision to Be Who You Truly Are
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: A slim, urgent book on the divisions fracturing modern society and the single decision Walsch believes heals them. Written to be read in an evening and acted on the next morning.

books.title: The Storm Before the Calm
books.author: Neale Donald Walsch
books.description: Book 1 of Conversations with Humanity, reframing global crisis as the turbulence that precedes a genuine shift. An invitation to participate in the conversation rather than simply read about it.

courses.title: The Spiritual Mentoring Program
courses.description: A 90-day mentoring intensive in which Walsch personally guides a capped group of 25 through three month-long explorations — Mastering Change, Mastering Happiness, Mastering Now. Includes weekly lesson plans, group coaching calls and one-to-one consultations with Neale himself.

courses.title: Advanced Integrations
courses.description: Walsch's flagship ongoing membership for people who want to live and teach the CWG material rather than simply read it. Twice-weekly live Zoom sessions with Neale, weekly "Going By The Book" classes, 60+ recorded lessons and a video library growing by ten hours a month.

courses.title: Wisdom that Works: The CWG Online School
courses.description: A 24-lesson written curriculum across three progressive levels, built on the 25 Core Concepts of Conversations with God. Every submission receives personal feedback from CWG life coach Annie Sims, trained by Walsch since 2005, and access never expires.
courses.price: $120 USD (Level One) or $288 USD (all three levels)

courses.title: Our Final Frontier: A Journey to Mastery in Living
courses.description: An eight-week self-paced masterclass of 24 video modules on accessing divine presence, understanding identity as part of God, and manifesting abundance. Includes three recorded mentoring sessions, MP3s, transcripts and five bonus programmes.

courses.title: Discover Your Soul's Purpose
courses.description: An eight-week masterclass co-taught with Michael Bernard Beckwith, exploring the nature of the soul, pre-incarnational choices and alignment with life's mission. Sixteen video modules plus two recorded mentoring sessions.

courses.title: The Art & Science of Living Consciously
courses.description: Sixteen self-paced video modules co-taught with Steve Farrell on shifting thought, word and action toward sharing, stewardship and recognising the Divine in all things. Framed as training for active participation in humanity's conscious evolution.

courses.title: Awaken The Species
courses.description: Walsch's 9.2-hour Mindvalley programme translating the Book 4 material into a structured quest on uncovering divinity across sixteen key areas of life. Production values and community support are the strongest of anything in his catalogue.

courses.title: CWG Connect
courses.description: The entry-level CWG community platform, giving members "Ask Neale" access, the CWG Village discussion forums, and two full-length books — When Everything Changes, Change Everything and The Storm Before the Calm. Account creation required.

courses.title: CWG for Parents: Family Enrichment Kit
courses.description: A downloadable 27-page Family Enrichment Guide covering ten life principles, with conversation starters, games and activities, plus 52 BE-DO-HAVE affirmation cards. Built for families wanting to pass the CWG material to the next generation.

courses.title: When Everything Changes 1-Day Intensive (MP3)
courses.description: Over seven hours of Walsch teaching live from a full-day intensive on navigating upheaval, delivered as MP3. The deepest single audio immersion available outside his live programmes.

courses.title: God's Message To The World Audiobook (Unabridged)
courses.description: The unabridged audiobook of Walsch's correction of seventeen mistaken beliefs about the Divine. Hearing these in his own cadence lands differently from reading them.

courses.title: Changing Change TeleClass
courses.description: A recorded teleclass on altering your relationship to change itself rather than trying to control circumstances. A compact, affordable way into the When Everything Changes framework.

courses.title: Happier Than God TeleClass
courses.description: A 90-minute recorded class with Walsch working through the personal-creation material at the heart of Happier Than God. Practical, example-led and easy to revisit.

courses.title: Home With God TeleSeminar
courses.description: Walsch's first-ever recorded discussion of the Home with God material, on death as homecoming rather than ending. Frequently sought out by people sitting with grief or a diagnosis.

free_resources.title: Part of the Change: Your Role as a Spiritual Helper
free_resources.description: A complete Walsch booklet, free as a direct PDF with no gate of any kind, setting out ten practical steps for becoming a spiritual helper during humanity's transition. It blends the philosophical core of the New Spirituality with concrete exercises, recommended reading and suggested practices like Heart Circles.

free_resources.title: The CWG Weekly Bulletin
free_resources.description: New writing from Walsch published weekly by the Conversations with God Foundation, fully readable on the site without subscribing. Each issue pairs a reader's letter with Neale's response and a short teaching, making it a genuine ongoing practice rather than a marketing feed.
